text:
Marta Chen: Quick kickoff - we need to converge on doc + SDK terminology. Goal: canonical glossary, migration guide, safe SDK deprecation plan. Who can pick things up? :wave:
Jake Patel: I can sweep SDK snippets (Node/TS). Will search-replace in examples and provide a codemod. ETA today afternoon.
Eli Gomez: I'll own the glossary canonical list and a short rationale for each rename.
Marta Chen: Draft candidate mappings: model_version -> model_ref, model_alias -> model_tag, dedicated_capacity -> dedicated, private_deploy -> private_deployment. Also decide param casing per language.
Samira V: I'll run a link/anchor audit and prepare redirects. Anchors break builds; will include redirects file in PR.
Jake Patel: Clarify: are we renaming public API method names or only examples/params? Breaking public APIs needs aliases.
Eli Gomez: Proposal: update docs/examples immediately. For SDK APIs, add alias wrappers that warn and stay for two releases, then remove. Include migration snippet showing both usages.
Marta Chen: Migration doc outline: glossary, quick snippet updates, SDK alias plan, redirects, rollout timeline and checklist.
Noah (docs-bot): Link-checker found several broken anchors referencing old names in /docs/reference; will attach list to the redirects PR.
Samira V: I'll triage the anchors and post candidate redirects; please review before merge to avoid collisions.
Jake Patel: I'll also update CI snippet tests where exact-string asserts break and flag them in PR. I can include optional codemod for maintainers.
Eli Gomez: I'll add semantic notes (why model_ref vs model_tag) and link to model lifecycle docs to prevent future drift.
Marta Chen: Owners & branches: glossary -> @Eli (docs/glossary/rename-2026), SDK snippets -> @Jake (sdk/snippets/terminology-sweep), redirects -> @Samira (docs/redirects/termino-fix), migration guide -> me (docs/migration/terminology-2026).
Jake Patel: Opening a draft PR now.
Samira V: Running link-checker and will post results in PR comments.
Marta Chen: Timeline: low-risk docs changes merged within 1 week; SDK aliasing staged over 2 releases. I'll post migration draft by EOD unless objections.
Jake Patel: No objections, starting work now.
Eli Gomez: Will draft glossary today.
Samira V: On it - will surface any anchor collisions.
(No further replies)
